claims.claim: foreign used 2024 Toyota Tacoma TRD 4x4 with V6 engine
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Toyota pickup with a visible “V6” badge on the tailgate area, but year/trim (2024, TRD) and 4x4 drivetrain are not confirmed in the photos.
No interior/ignition or dashboard controls are shown in the witness photos.
No roof/inside photos are shown to confirm a moonroof.
No documents (duty/clearance papers) are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Drivetrain/trim mismatch (e.g., not actually TRD or not actually 4x4) which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the drivetrain/trim indicators (e.g., 4x4 selector/transfer case area, TRD badge on grille/side, or dashboard screen showing 4WD mode) plus a VIN decode screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Toyota Tacoma with only the visible V6 badge, with drivetrain/trim assumed unknown.

risks.risk: Engine/condition risk (V6 badge may not reflect actual engine health; could have issues like smoke, overheating, or misfire).
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start (engine start), then 1–2 minutes idle with no abnormal smoke, plus a short rev test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing mechanical attention (as-is, not confirmed running perfectly).

risks.risk: Transmission and drivetrain behavior (automatic/manual, gearbox smoothness, clutch/shift issues).
risks.proof: Video clip showing gear engagement (P->R->D or 1->2->3) and smooth shifting, plus a short drive clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as transmission condition unknown (worst-case: may require service).

risks.risk: Body condition and rust/accident repair not visible from exterior front/rear shots (panel alignment, dents, repainting).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both sides and corners (wheel arches, door edges, tailgate seams), and a straight-on shot of panel gaps; include underbody/rust spots if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cosmetic/structural issues until close-ups confirm otherwise.

risks.risk: Tyre condition and matching set (tread depth, brand, uneven wear) affects immediate replacement cost.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of all four tyres with tread depth visible (or a coin-depth/tread gauge photo) and brand/model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres may be worn and may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Interior/AC/electronics not confirmed (moonroof/push-to-start claims also depend on interior).
risks.proof: Interior photos: dashboard/center console showing push-to-start button, roof area showing moonroof, and a video of AC blowing cold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as interior/AC unverified (worst-case: may need repairs).

risks.risk: Documentation/duty clearance risk (seller says verified duty, but without documents it may be untrue).
risks.proof: Photos/scans of clearance/duty documents, VIN/registration papers, and a current status/receipt showing it is cleared for sale in Abuja.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documentation not confirmed (worst-case: buyer may face delays or inability to register).

proof_requests: Send VIN and a VIN decode screenshot (to confirm year, trim, engine, and drivetrain).
Provide photos of the 4x4/transfer case selector or dashboard 4WD indicator (to confirm 4x4 vs 4x2).
Show interior: push-to-start button area and roof/ceiling showing moonroof.
Provide a cold-start video (engine start) and a short drive video (gear shifts and no warning lights).
Send close-up body photos (both sides, wheel arches, door edges, tailgate seams) and any rust/repair spots.
Send tyre close-ups for all four tyres with tread depth and brand/model markings.
Provide duty/clearance and registration documents (receipts, clearance papers, and current status).
response.reason: The witness photos confirm it is a Toyota Tacoma with a visible V6 badge, but key value drivers and the seller’s major claims (2024/TRD/4x4, push-to-start, moonroof, and verified duty) are not verifiable from the provided images. Missing proof prevents confident worst-case pricing without risking a mismatch.
